Dear Ariad team,

I'm applying for the E-commerce & Digital Content Coordinator role. With hands-on experience managing CMS content, optimizing product pages, and analyzing performance in GA4, I'm drawn to the opportunity to help a leading retail brand grow online.

At Episto, I publish and update pages, blogs, and media for client websites in WordPress, and I've worked on Shopify stores (harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com) handling product catalogues and blog content. I also use GA4, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to turn data into content and merchandising improvements. My SEO/GEO background means I can contribute to visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and while my Dutch is currently at B1 writing / A2+ speaking, I'm actively improving and comfortable working in English. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your client's e-commerce growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Ariad team,

I'm writing to apply for the E-commerce & Digital Content Coordinator position. Your focus on optimizing online customer experiences for leading European brands resonates with my own work at the intersection of SEO, content, and web.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites in WordPress, publishing and updating pages, blog posts, and media. I've also worked on Shopify stores (harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com), where I handled store design, product catalogue maintenance, and blog content. This has given me a structured, detail-oriented approach to product publishing and content accuracy.

I use Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs daily to track performance and translate data into actionable recommendations. My SEO and GEO expertise—including structured data, entity optimization, and AI search visibility—allows me to contribute to both traditional and emerging search channels. I'm also comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams, having supported projects for clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium. My Dutch is currently at B1 writing / A2+ speaking, and I'm actively improving it; I work fluently in English. I'm eager to bring my proactive attitude and commercial mindset to a dynamic retail environment.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your client's e-commerce growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
